name: survival-game-prototype
description: 2D top-down Viking survival crafting game: editors and prototypes

scripts.test: node tests/ctest2.js && node tests/ctest4.js && node tests/btest3.js && node tests/ktest.js && node tests/turntest.js && node tests/wtest2.js && node tests/sprinttest.js && node tests/fuzz.js && node tests/weapons.js && node tests/ring.js && node tests/gather.js && node tests/iron.js && node tests/karve.js && node tests/fishing.js && node tests/runes30.js
scripts.art:hero: node tools/blender.js art/build/hero_build.py && node tools/blender.js art/build/render.py -- art/source/hero.blend art/render/hero && node tools/sprites.js hero
scripts.art:styles: node tools/blender.js art/build/hero2_build.py && node tools/blender.js art/build/render.py -- art/source/hero2.blend art/render/hero2_cel --dirs 4 --frames 4 --walkframes 6 --layers body --ortho 1.72 --style cel && node tools/blender.js art/build/render.py -- art/source/hero2.blend art/render/hero2_painted --dirs 4 --frames 4 --walkframes 6 --layers body --ortho 1.72 --style painted && node tools/blender.js art/build/render.py -- art/source/hero2.blend art/render/hero2_folk --dirs 4 --frames 4 --walkframes 6 --layers body --ortho 1.72 --style folk && node tools/visual/herostyles.js

scripts.art:items: node tools/blender.js art/build/items_build.py && node tools/blender.js art/build/render.py -- art/source/hero2_mixamo.blend art/render/items_a --anims idle,walk,run,attack1,attack2,hit --dirs 8 --frames idle=100,walk=12,run=10,attack1=12,attack2=12,hit=8 --layers swordWood,swordMetal,clubWood --ortho 2.02 --style cel --scene day && node tools/blender.js art/build/render.py -- art/source/hero2_mixamo.blend art/render/items_b --anims idle,walk,run,chop,mine,hit --dirs 8 --frames idle=100,walk=12,run=10,chop=12,mine=12,hit=8 --layers axeWood,axeMetal,pickWood,pickMetal,knifeWood,knifeMetal --ortho 2.02 --style cel --scene day && node tools/blender.js art/build/render.py -- art/source/hero2_mixamo.blend art/render/items_c --anims idle,walk,run,bow_draw,bow_shoot,hit --dirs 8 --frames idle=100,walk=12,run=10,bow_draw=8,bow_shoot=6,hit=8 --layers bowWood --ortho 2.02 --style cel --scene day && python3 art/build/items_merge.py && node tools/sprites.js hero2-mixamo art/render/hero2_mixamo assets/sprites/hero2-mixamo
scripts.art:icons: node tools/blender.js art/build/items_icons.py && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('assets/sprites/items',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('art/render/icons'))fs.copyFileSync('art/render/icons/'+f,'assets/sprites/items/'+f)"
